method: Manual same-frame paired clock readings; original frames retained. 25 roughly 1s-spaced frames reviewed; ambiguous/transition digits excluded; frame447 added as separately inspected evidence. Small descriptive sample, not a certification.
limitations: Clock quantization/readout and video compression introduce roughly 10ms-scale uncertainty; this is not a calibrated accuracy bound.
Reference and HDMI clocks lie on different recording-image rows. Recording-camera rolling-shutter direction/readout time are unknown. No assumed 12ms subtraction.
Phone-display update phase, sensor exposure/rolling readout and monitor scan/processing contribute to optical measurement.
Video does not identify the bitstream hash. OSD CALC about14ms is distinct from optical latency.
